sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A life without health is like a river without water.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ lˈaɪf wɪðˈaʊt hˈɛlθ ɪz lˈaɪk ɐ ɹˈɪvə wɪðˈaʊt wˈɔːtə./
sentences.meaning: 没有健康的生活就像一条没有水的河流。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: learn how to have a healthy lifestyle.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɜːn hˌaʊ tə hav ɐ hˈɛlθi lˈaɪfstaɪl./
sentences.meaning: 学会如何拥有健康的生活方式。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A healthy lifestyle is very important for us.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ hˈɛlθi lˈaɪfstaɪl ɪz vˈɛɹi ɪmpˈɔːtᵊnt fɔː ˌʌs./
sentences.meaning: 健康的生活方式对我们非常重要。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s discuss our ideas about healthy ways of life.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɛts dɪskˈʌs ˌaʊə aɪdˈɪəz əbˈaʊt hˈɛlθi wˈeɪz ɒv lˈaɪf./
sentences.meaning: 让我们讨论我们关于健康生活方式的想法。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Here are some pictures of different foods.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ hˈɪə ɑː sˌʌm pˈɪkʧəz ɒv dˈɪfəɹənt fˈuːdz./
sentences.meaning: 这里有一些不同食物的照片。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Look at the pictures and put the food into the correct groups in the table below.
sentences.ipa: /lˈʊk at ðə pˈɪkʧəz and pˌʊt ðə fˈuːd ˈɪntuː ðə kəɹˈɛkt ɡɹˈuːps ɪn ðə tˈeɪbᵊl bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 看照片，把食物放入下表中正确的组。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Millie and Daniel are talking about what food they like.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː mˈɪli and dˈanjəl ɑː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt wˌɒt fˈuːd ðeɪ lˈaɪk./
sentences.meaning: B 米莉和丹尼尔在谈论他们喜欢的食物

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in pairs and discuss what food you like to eat.
sentences.ipa: /wˈɜːk ɪn pˈɛːz and dɪskˈʌs wˌɒt fˈuːd juː lˈaɪk tʊ ˈiːt./
sentences.meaning: 成对地工作，讨论你喜欢吃什么食物。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːz ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn bɪlˈəʊ az ɐ mˈɒdᵊl./

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: I drink milk every day. How about you, Daniel?
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ dɹˈɪŋk mˈɪlk ˈɛvəɹi dˈeɪ. hˌaʊ əbˈaʊt juː, dˈanjəl?/
sentences.meaning: 我每天都会喝牛奶 你呢，丹尼尔？

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Me too. I also like eggs. It’s healthy for us to have milk and eggs often. They’re good for us.
sentences.ipa: /mˌiː tˈuː. ˌaɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ lˈaɪk ˈɛɡz. ˌɪts hˈɛlθi fɔː ˌʌs tə hav mˈɪlk and ˈɛɡz ˈɒfᵊn. ðˌɛː ɡˈʊd fɔː ˌʌs./
sentences.meaning: ▁我也是，我也喜欢鸡蛋。经常吃牛奶和鸡蛋对我们是健康的。它们对我们有好处。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use “Me too” to show that we share the same feeling or opinion as the other person.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː jˈuːz “mˌiː tˈuː” tə ʃˈəʊ ðat wiː ʃˈɛː ðə sˈeɪm fˈiːlɪŋ ɔː əpˈɪnjən az ði ˈʌðə pˈɜːsᵊn./
sentences.meaning: 我们也使用“我”来表明，我们与其他人有着同样的感觉或看法。

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Yes. I eat an egg every morning. I also like fish. Fish is good for our health.
sentences.ipa: /jˈɛs. ˌaɪ ˈiːt ɐn ˈɛɡ ˈɛvəɹi mˈɔːnɪŋ. ˌaɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ lˈaɪk fˈɪʃ. fˈɪʃ ɪz ɡˈʊd fɔː ˌaʊə hˈɛlθ./
sentences.meaning: 对 我每天早上都吃鸡蛋 我也喜欢鱼 鱼对我们的健康有好处。

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: I like meat. It’s delicious.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈaɪk mˈiːt. ˌɪts dɪlˈɪʃəs./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢肉 这是美味的。

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: What else do you often eat?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt ˈɛls dˈuː juː ˈɒfᵊn ˈiːt?/

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Carrots. They’re great for our eyes!
sentences.ipa: /kˈaɹəts. ðˌɛː ɡɹˈeɪt fɔː ˌaʊə ˈaɪz!/
sentences.meaning: 胡萝卜 他们对我们的眼睛是很好的！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C What other foods do you know?
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː wˌɒt ˈʌðə fˈuːdz dˈuː juː nˈəʊ?/
sentences.meaning: C 你知道其他什么食物吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Write them down in the table of Part A.
sentences.ipa: /ɹˈaɪt ðˌɛm dˌaʊn ɪn ðə tˈeɪbᵊl ɒv pˈɑːt ˈeɪ/
sentences.meaning: 把它们写在A部分的桌子上

sentences.text: healthy or not?

sentences.text: Why or why not?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I love dancing.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈʌv dˈɑːnsɪŋ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I dance for half an hour every day.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ dˈɑːns fɔː hˈɑːf ɐn ˈaʊə ˈɛvəɹi dˈeɪ./

sentences.meaning: 我每晚都睡9小时 所以我总是充满精力

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It is important for me to keep fit.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt ɪz ɪmpˈɔːtᵊnt fɔː mˌiː tə kˈiːp fˈɪt./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I also have a healthy diet.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ hav ɐ hˈɛlθi dˈaɪət./
sentences.meaning: 我也有一个健康的饮食。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I never go to school without breakfast.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ nˈɛvə ɡˌəʊ tə skˈuːl wɪðˈaʊt bɹˈɛkfəst./
sentences.meaning: 我从来没有上学 没有早餐。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I often have a pancake and some milk.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈɒfᵊn hav ɐ pˈankeɪk and sˌʌm mˈɪlk./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: For lunch, I like fish, meat and tofu.
sentences.ipa: /fˌɔː lˈʌnʧ, ˌaɪ lˈaɪk fˈɪʃ, mˈiːt and tˈəʊfuː./
sentences.meaning: 午餐时 我喜欢鱼肉豆腐

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I also eat lots of fruit and vegetables every day.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ ˈiːt lˈɒts ɒv fɹˈuːt and vˈɛʤɪtəbᵊlz ˈɛvəɹi dˈeɪ./
sentences.meaning: 我每天都吃很多水果和蔬菜。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ sˈɛldəm ˈiːt kˈeɪks ɔː swˈiːts./

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /tˈuː mˈʌʧ ʃˈʊɡə ɪz bˈad fɔː ˌaʊə tˈiːθ./
sentences.meaning: 太多糖对我们的牙齿有害

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ɐm ɐ hˈəʊmbˌɒdi./

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ dˈəʊnt ˈɛksəsaɪz vˈɛɹi ˈɒfᵊn./

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈʌv bˈiːf and mˈʌtᵊn, bˌʌt ˌaɪ dˈəʊnt ˈiːt ɐ lˈɒt ɒv vˈɛʤɪtəbᵊlz./

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ hav ɐ swˈiːt tˈuːθ and ɪt ɪz hˈɑːd fɔː mˌiː tə sˈeɪ nˈəʊ tə kˈeɪks./
sentences.meaning: 我有一个甜的牙齿， 我很难说不对蛋糕。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Sometimes I stay up late.
sentences.ipa: /sˈʌmtaɪmz ˌaɪ stˈeɪ ˌʌp lˈeɪt./

sentences.meaning: 我的生活方式是不健康的。

sentences.meaning: 我需要得到足够的睡眠。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ plˈan tʊ ˈiːt mˈɔː fɹˈuːt and vˈɛʤɪtəbᵊlz and lˈɛs ʃˈʊɡə./
sentences.meaning: 我打算多吃点水果和蔬菜 少吃点糖

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /spˈɔːt ɪz ɡˈʊd fɔː maɪ hˈɛlθ tˈuː./
sentences.meaning: 运动对我的健康也有好处。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.meaning: 我打算每个星期去游泳。

sentences.ipa: /ɐ kəmplˈiːt ðə ʧˈɑːt bɪlˈəʊ əbˈaʊt kˈɪtiz and dˈanjəlz lˈaɪfstaɪlz wɪð ði ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃᵊn ɪn ði ˈɑːtɪkᵊlz./

sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː bˈəʊθ kˈɪti and dˈanjəl hav ɐ swˈiːt tˈuːθ./
sentences.meaning: 4，凯蒂和丹尼尔都有一颗甜牙。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 Daniel has a healthy diet.
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv dˈanjəl haz ɐ hˈɛlθi dˈaɪət./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 Daniel plans to change his unhealthy lifestyle.
sentences.ipa: /sˈɪks dˈanjəl plˈanz tə ʧˈeɪnʤ hɪz ʌnhˈɛlθi lˈaɪfstaɪl./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Is your diet healthy?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn ˌɪz jɔː dˈaɪət hˈɛlθi?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A countable noun refers to something we can count.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ kˈaʊntəbᵊl nˈaʊn ɹɪfˈɜːz tə sˈʌmθɪŋ wiː kan kˈaʊnt./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use a or an before a singular countable noun.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: If the noun starts with a vowel sound, we use an.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪf ðə nˈaʊn stˈɑːts wɪð ɐ vˈaʊəl sˈaʊnd, wiː jˈuːz ɐn./

sentences.text: a banana.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ bənˈɑːnə./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: cake.
sentences.ipa: /kˈeɪk./
sentences.meaning: 蛋糕 蛋糕 蛋糕 蛋糕 蛋糕 蛋糕

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /ˈɛɡ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: To form the plural of most countable nouns, we add -s to the singular form.

sentences.meaning: 要形成最可数名词的复数，我们在单数形式中加上-s。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /haʊˈɛvə, ðɛː ɑː sˌʌm ɪksˈɛpʃᵊnz./
